newsitem.title: USA: United Airlines extends summer fare sale.
newsitem.headline: United Airlines extends summer fare sale.

text.p: United Airlines said Friday it will extend the deadline for buying tickets under its summer fare sale through May 16.
The operating unit of UAL Corp said the promotion offers discounts of as much as 40 percent from normal 21-day advance purchase fares.
United said the extension will give families an additional 17 days to lock in fares for travel to all 50 states and Canada through October 8.
The previous deadline for buying tickets was April 29.
The lowest fares are available on off-peak travel days of Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday and other restrictions also apply, United said.
UAL shares were off 2-1/4 Friday at 73-3/4.
